title: Ruodhwa Yesu Oseluongowa
stanzas: Ruodhwa Yesu oseluongowa, Mondo wachop e kiserane; Wan to wanabed nade chieng`no, Ka Ruodhwa biro?
Enoruake gi duong` mar polo, G`osimbo mar duong`ne mar locho;Osimb kudho ok nonen kendo, Ka Ruodhwa biro.
Ji man gi lep kisera nomor, Nikech noruakgi e kisera; Wan johawi ka Ruoth noyienwa, Ka Ruodhwa biro.
Ji modagi noyuagi chieng`no, Kiriembogi a e kisera; Nobed malich miwuoro chieng`no, Ka Ruodhwa biro.
Ruoth mondo imiwa ng`wononi, Wan duto, jogi maritoi; Mondo kik waluor ka waneni, Kiwiro,Ruodhwa.
chorus: Chieng`no ma Ruodhwa biro, Chieng`no mobiro, Wanabed nade e chieng`no, In kod an bende?
